text:
mira: heads up — saw two OOMs on p3-prod batchers at 03:12 UTC. stack shows KV cache footprint spike when kernel route chose 'matmul_fused_v2'. suspect memory amplification during kernel path switch :thinking:

ci-bot: alert: gpu-node-7 OOM at 2026-03-15T03:12:04Z

sam: logs? sample batch id?

mira: batch 0x4f7c, seq lens [64, 512, 1024], kv_bytes ~1.8GB, pre-switch RSS ~5.2GB then jumped to ~8.9GB before oom. attaching profiler snippet:

alex: ```
# profiler summary (hot path)
kernel: matmul_fused_v2 -- temp_alloc 3.2GB
kernel: matmul_streaming -- temp_alloc 200MB
batcher: continuous_v2
kv_cache: 1.82GB
estimated_total=kv_cache + temp_alloc + model_params = ~9.6GB
``` 

mia: interesting — matmul_fused_v2 creates big temps for long seqs, we usually route to it for perf. under KV pressure it's dangerous. we should add a quick pre-admit check that computes projected transient alloc and rejects/adapts.

raj: propose heuristic: projected_peak = kv_bytes + kernel_temp_est(seq_len, batch_shape) + reserve_headroom(0.075*gpu_kv_capacity)
if projected_peak > gpu_kv_capacity -> fallback to matmul_streaming or decrease token_budget for that request.

sam: agree. can we estimate kernel_temp cheaply? maybe precomputed per-model per-seq-length table. cheap lookup.

alex: we have per-model kernel profiles. quick check: for seq=1024 temp for fused_v2 ~= 3.0GB, streaming ~=0.18GB. simple lookup works.

mia: also add queue-side policy: when a queued req is flagged as "high-kv" (kv_bytes > threshold) reduce its token_budget by 30% and deprioritize admission for fused kernels. that avoids head-of-line causing OOM.

mira: what's the perf tradeoff? if we fallback kernels, latency changes?

alex: canary results (local sim): fallback -> p50 +2ms, p95 +8ms on long seqs, throughput drop ~1.6% but no OOMs in 12h sim.

raj: sounds acceptable for safety. we'll need telemetry: metrics kv_projected_drop_rate, kernel_fallback_rate, batch_admit_rejects, and per-deployment OOM_count.

sam: plan: implement lookup + pre-admit check + queue flagging + canary on 10% of p3-prod for 72h. I'll own the rollout.

mira: assign tasks: sam -> impl + canary, alex -> add kernel temp table and perf test, mia -> dashboard + alerting, raj -> docs and config knobs.

sam: started a PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/12345 -- it's minimal change to admission path. :eyes:

ci-bot: deploy job queued: job-89123, triggered by sam. status: pending.

mira: good. if we still see OOMs after rollout we'll escalate to emergency kernel revert. thanks all.

alex: quick note — consider tuning reserve_headroom to 10% on crowded nodes; we can make it dynamic later.

mia: +1 on dynamic headroom but iterate after canary.

sam: will post PR link and logs once canary starts.

mira: :thumbsup:
